name: Hinterlands Honey Ripple
summary: Crates of Hinterlands Honey Ripple sit at an abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock. Gilveradin Sunchaser wants the bottles to package for Dran Droffers.

sections.title: Crates at Skulk Rock
sections.body: The crates at Skulk Rock hold Hinterlands Honey Ripple, an unusual drink sought by Dran Droffers. The abandoned Horde base lies among slime covered ruins, where the bottles must be gathered with care. Gilveradin Sunchaser has the original packaging and will wrap the bottles for Dran.

faq.q: Where can I find Hinterlands Honey Ripple?
faq.answer: Hinterlands Honey Ripple is in crates around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.
Dran Droffers, Malton’s father, seeks Hinterlands Honey Ripple. Gilveradin Sunchaser asks you to gather the bottles so he can package them for Dran.

faq.q: Why does Dran need the bottles intact?
faq.answer: Gilveradin Sunchaser, who packages the ripple for Dran, says the bottles must not be bruised because jostling spoils the drink’s bouquet. He has the empty packaging for the ripple.
It is a bottled drink kept in crates at the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.

angles.text: The bottles lie in crates at an abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.
